channel_a_recovery_investigation.outcome: P0 ABORTED — CHANNEL A RECOVERY INCOMPLETE. Ten recovery mechanisms attempted and documented (workspace/attachment scan, platform-internal storage, local and remote git archaeology, GitHub releases/issues/PRs/repos/gists, global code search, public web, connected-app inventory); no Channel A artifact recoverable; originals exist only in the platform conversation store.

provenance_facts.original_platform_origin_byte_streams: REMAIN UNAVAILABLE to the current repository workflow. No original-stream hash exists; none was ever computed; none is invented by this amendment.

integrity_vs_authenticity.working_copy_integrity: ESTABLISHED — each of the six files carries a mechanically computed SHA-256 (fresh calculation this pass from actual file bytes), each matching its digest in spec/SHA256SUMS and PUBLICATION_SHA256SUMS; anyone can re-verify the published bytes against the recorded digests. The corpus is self-consistent and unaltered since hashing/publication.
integrity_vs_authenticity.original_source_authenticity: NOT ESTABLISHED — no byte-for-byte equality with the originally emitted platform messages has been or can be established without byte-accessible originals. Integrity and authenticity are different verifications and are recorded separately here, as required by the corpus README §9.

provenance_facts.content_match_assessment: File existence verified; required sections verified present in each file (per-candidate section_evidence above); contents match the intended transcript-derived document ranges as far as the available evidence permits — that evidence is internal consistency, section completeness, and the transcript-as-appeal-authority process record; it is not byte-level comparison against originals.

p0_closure.rationale: All mandatory conditions of the Channel B procedure are satisfied: (1) the owner's explicit authorization is recorded verbatim with its date; (2) all six baseline candidates exist, are section-complete per E-11 §0.4v2 step 2 and the standing amendment's required_material, and carry fresh, mechanically computed SHA-256 digests matching their published anchors; (3) each is classified TRANSCRIPT-DERIVED USER-ATTESTED BASELINE, never as an original; (4) the Channel A investigation record and its negative outcome are referenced; (5) the integrity/authenticity distinction and the baseline scope are recorded; (6) all six non-claims are recorded. The owner's authorization is an explicit waiver of the original-source-hash acceptance route; under that recorded waiver the fail-stop of E-11 §0.4v2 step 6 is remediated by formal reclassification of the acceptance baseline — not by original-source recovery, which remains incomplete.
p0_closure.what_pass_does_not_mean: This disposition attests baseline acceptance only. It is NOT evidence that any experiment ran, any gate passed, any compiler behavior was observed, or any runtime parity exists. It does NOT cure, diminish, or reinterpret the Channel A failure; original-source provenance remains INCOMPLETE and is recorded as such in the immediate clarification.
